camel_example: aliyun waf-openapi ModifyDefenseResourceGroup --region cn-hangzhou --GroupName test01 --InstanceId waf_cdnsdf30000 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
description_en: Modifies the configuration of a protected object group
description_zh: 修改防护对象组配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi modify-defense-resource-group --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --group-name test01 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDefenseResourceGroup

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to obtain the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the protected object group to modify
parameters.help_zh: 要修改的防护对象组名称
parameters.name: group_name

parameters.help_en: The protected objects to add to the protected object group. Separate multiple protected objects with commas (,). If this parameter is empty, no protected objects are added to the protected object group
parameters.help_zh: 要添加到防护对象组中的防护对象。多个防护对象之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔。该参数为空，表示防护对象组不添加任何防护对象
parameters.name: add_list

parameters.help_en: The protected objects to remove from the protected object group. Separate multiple protected objects with commas (,). If this parameter is empty, no protected objects are removed from the protected object group
parameters.help_zh: 要从防护对象组中删除的防护对象。多个防护对象之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔。该参数为空，表示不从防护对象组中删除任何防护对象
parameters.name: delete_list

parameters.help_en: The description of the protected object group. The description can be up to 512 characters long
parameters.help_zh: 防护对象组描述信息。最大支持512个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is located. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id
